slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Definition: two figures are similar if a dilation followed by a sequence of rigid motions maps one onto the other.

Similar figures have equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides; the ratio is the scale factor. Congruent figures are similar with k = 1.

All circles are similar: translate one circle's center onto the other's, then dilate about that center by the ratio of the radii, r2/r1.

slides.title: Check yourself
slides.html: Circle A has radius 3 and circle B radius 7.5. Describe a similarity that maps A onto B.
slides.reveal: Translate A's center to B's center, then dilate about it by 7.5/3 = 2.5.
